hints.title: Reachable Interval Invariant
hints.text: Suppose we can currently form all values in range [0, current_max]. Adding a coin c allows us to form [c, current_max + c].

hints.title: Greedy Interval Extension
hints.text: Sort the given coins. If current_max + 1 < coin, we cannot form current_max + 1, so greedily add coin current_max + 1 to double reachable upper bound.

hints.title: Absorbing Available Coins
hints.text: Once current_max + 1 >= coin, we can absorb the coin and expand the reachable bound to current_max + coin.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minimumAddedCoins(self, coins: List[int], target: int) -> int:
        coins.sort()
        curr_max = 0
        added = 0
        idx = 0
        n = len(coins)
        while curr_max < target:
            if idx < n and coins[idx] <= curr_max + 1:
                curr_max += coins[idx]
                idx += 1
            else:
                curr_max += curr_max + 1
                added += 1
        return added
```

complexity.notes: Sorting coins followed by logarithmic greedy interval expansion.
